_comment: GraphVisor queues, declared in IARAG's vhost by sync-to-rabbit.sh. Only graphvisor_* names are allowed; nothing is ever deleted. graphvisor_ingest holds its message unacked for a whole document (dozens to hundreds of LLM calls), so it raises RabbitMQ's 30-min default consumer timeout to 6 h for this queue only. Queue arguments can't change after creation: to change them, delete the (empty) queue by hand and re-run the sync.
